headline: Names a New York City post office building after the Tuskegee Airmen.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building at 99 Macombs Place in New York, New York, as the "Tuskegee Airmen Post Office Building." It is a symbolic naming measure and does not change postal services, rules, or funding. The official summary describes only this designation.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 24, 2018, and the designation took effect on that date.
